_about: Hand-edited fixes and settings layered on top of oddsparks.json (which is generated: never edit it). Checked by `npm run validate`. Every entry needs a source; items, buildings, corrections and mergeRecipes also need a reason (sparkCrews and confirmed carry their evidence in the source). Field paths: duration, usesFuel, randomised, cycles, temperature, inputs.<item>.amount, outputs.<item>.amount, outputs.<item>.odds. Recipe, item and crew ids are stored in users' saved tabs: never change one without adding the old id to renamedIds. See docs/plan.md section 4 and the update-game-data skill.
